# Starting a new conference year

Once a year, after the conference wraps up, the site moves to the next
year. The checklist of record is `conferences/_template/README.md`. This
chapter is the overview so you know what the steps are for.

## The steps

1. **Archive the year that ended.** Move the live files
   (`conferences/index.qmd`, `index.css`, `images/`, `data/`, `cfp/`, and
   `preconference/`) into `conferences/archive/` under the year that just
   ended. Then open the archived `index.qmd` and change its two archive
   links (the Archives tile and the Learn More button) to `../index.qmd`
   so they lead back to the new current page. The archived pages keep
   reading their own year's `data/` folder, so they stay frozen in time.
2. **Copy the template.** Copy everything in `conferences/_template/` up
   into `conferences/`. Copy, do not move, so the template stays clean for
   the following year.
3. **Replace the placeholders.** The comment at the top of the new
   `index.qmd` lists every placeholder: the year, city, dates, and hotel.
   "Replace in Files" in RStudio or VS Code handles each one in a single
   pass. The same placeholders appear in the seed CSVs in `data/`, so run
   the replacements there too.
4. **Add the images.** Save the new conference logo as `images/logo.png`
   and a hotel photo as `images/hotel.png` in `conferences/images/`.
5. **Set up the Google Sheet.** Hand the conference Sheet to the new
   co-chairs (or make next year's copy with the structure documented in
   `conferences/_update-conference.R`), then run
   `source("conferences/_update-conference.R")` to pull it into the site.

## One step outside the conference folder

The Conferences menu in the site navbar names the current year. After the
rollover, open `_quarto.yml` in the project root, find the Conferences
menu, and update the label to the new year. The link itself does not
change; only the label does.

## Then render and hand off

Render the conference pages and check them in the browser: the main page,
`cfp/index.qmd`, and `preconference/index.qmd`. When they look right,
share the changed files with the web editor as described in `UPDATING.md`.

The new page works immediately after step 3, with "coming soon" notes
everywhere. The rest of the year runs through the Google Sheet, as the
previous chapter describes.
